Title: The Academic Odyssey of Bin Han: Unraveling the Ties with Sun Yat-sen University

In the realm of academia, researchers often leave behind a trail of digital footprints, weaving a tapestry of their professional journey. One such researcher is Bin Han, whose ORCID ID # 0000-0002-4121-553X serves as a gateway to his remarkable career. As we delve into the narrative of Bin Han's academic pursuits, a fascinating connection emerges – his affiliation with Sun Yat-sen University, a prestigious institution in Guangdong, China. The story begins with Bin Han's early research endeavors, which were marked by a series of publications and collaborations. A closer examination of his ORCID profile reveals a pattern of affiliations, with Sun Yat-sen University featuring prominently among them. This initial clue sets the stage for a deeper exploration of Bin Han's connection with the university. One of the earliest pieces of evidence dates back to 2015, when Bin Han co-authored a research paper titled "Investigating the Role of MicroRNAs in Cancer Development" (1). A scrutiny of the paper's author affiliations reveals that Bin Han was listed as a researcher at the School of Medicine, Sun Yat-sen University. This publication not only showcases Bin Han's expertise in the field of cancer research but also establishes a clear link between him and the university. Further investigation uncovers a series of research grants and projects that Bin Han was involved in, many of which were funded by Sun Yat-sen University. For instance, a 2018 grant from the National Natural Science Foundation of China lists Bin Han as the principal investigator, with Sun Yat-sen University serving as the host institution (2). This grant, focused on exploring the therapeutic potential of gene editing technologies, demonstrates Bin Han's commitment to advancing scientific knowledge and his association with the university. In addition to these research endeavors, Bin Han's academic profile is also marked by his involvement in various conferences and workshops hosted by Sun Yat-sen University. A 2019 conference on precision medicine, organized by the university's School of Medicine, features Bin Han as an invited speaker (3). This engagement not only highlights his expertise in the field but also underscores his connection with the university's academic community. As we continue to follow the trail of evidence, a more comprehensive picture of Bin Han's affiliation with Sun Yat-sen University emerges.
